author: Church Machine
release_notes: Initial coordinator LUMP: calls SelfTest.Main, Tunnel.Register, RETURN.
source:
; ============================================================
; Abstraction:  WukongCallHome
; Description:  Wukong board software boot coordinator — simulator / IDE side.
;               Runs SelfTest, then calls Tunnel.Register with the result
;               so the IDE receives the board's boot_reason payload.
;
;               This is the LUMP executed by the Church Machine simulator
;               when the ⚡ boot entry is set to WukongCallHome (NS slot 7).
;               It is distinct from wukong_callhome.cloomc, which is the
;               exact hardware LED-blink ROM program burned into the Wukong
;               FPGA (an infinite loop with no RETURN, no capability calls).
;
; Sequence:
;   1. ELOADCALL SelfTest.Main  (c-list[0], NS slot 6)
;      → executes the hardware self-test; result code arrives in DR0
;   2. ELOADCALL Tunnel.Register (c-list[1], NS slot 8)
;      → registers DR0 as the boot_reason with the IDE host
;   3. RETURN to the boot-entry caller (IDE boot-complete handler)
;
; C-list layout (2 entries, injected by the lazy loader at runtime):
;   c-list[0]  SelfTest   E  (NS slot 6)   E-GT: 0x4A000006
;   c-list[1]  Tunnel     E  (NS slot 8)   E-GT: 0x4A000008
;
; Register usage:
;   DR0  SelfTest result code (passed through to Tunnel.Register)
;   All CRs are scratch; ELOADCALL manages CR internally.
;
; Slot:    NS slot 7  (WukongCallHome — Wukong board coordinator)
; Token:   e186c4ec
; Source:  simulator/examples/wukong_callhome_coordinator.cloomc
; Author:  Church Machine
; Version: 1.0
; ============================================================

capabilities {
    SelfTest  E,
    Tunnel    E
}

Main:
    ELOADCALL CR0, SelfTest, 0    ; [0] call SelfTest.Main → DR0 = test result
    ELOADCALL CR0, Tunnel, 0      ; [1] call Tunnel.Register(DR0) → IDE ACK
    RETURN                        ; [2] return to boot-entry caller
description: Wukong board software boot coordinator — runs SelfTest, calls Tunnel.Register, returns to IDE.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Run SelfTest, register result with Tunnel, return to IDE.
